reviews.title: Longest review I’ve ever written because IMO it’s worth it!
reviews.body: Okay, I wasn’t so sure about this before I bought it, but I was interested in seeing if it would work- now I don’t go a day without using it at least 10-15 minutes!Yes, this works for lymphatic drainage. The telltale sign that it does, is that until your body is use to it, you may notice your skin feeling itchy! That is your lymphatic drainage system at work!  The rapid movements stimulate nerves, increase blood and lymphatic circulation to the skin! And your body releases a small amount of histamine in response- which makes you feel itchy. Eventually you will build up a tolerance after repeated use! I got my mom using this and she started with 1 minute, then 5, until she built up that tolerance. So start slow and you should be fine- obviously in the rare case that you develop hives or the itching doesn’t seem to lessen with use- then I wouldn’t recommend continuing. After some research, that seems rare.Also- I did NOT buy this for any kind of skin tightening or cellulite reducing reasons- but I swear IT FIRMED MY LEGS?! I had stopped working out for like 6 months prior to buying this and started using this about a week after I got back to a regular workout routine and it was crazy how much quicker my legs seemed to firm. I wasn’t looking for or expecting that result. Just a happy bonus.Another bonus- MUSCLE RECOVERY. Another reason I don’t skip using daily is I feel it keeps my muscles relaxed and I’m not as sore after workouts as I would be if I didn’t use it.Other bonuses:-improved balance-a decent massager (sit down in front and rest your legs on it and ya got a good calf massager!)- Remote included: manually adjustable settings, 5 program options to save settings for next time, time settings, and quick-click buttons of low, medium, and high intensity.Overall, I’d say this is a quality purchase!Drawbacks: -Bulky (it’s a vibration plate though, so what do you expect).-Could be sturdier, but for the price I’m impressed!-Some might say it’s slightly noisy but I don’t think it’s that bad. I usually pop on an audio book/podcast/show and enjoy getting caught up while relaxing!

reviews.title: A must have for so
reviews.body: Wow!! I use a vibration plate at the gym so wanted one to use in the convenience of my home after my home workouts or long walks/runs. This far exceeded my expectations.  I actually prefer this one to the commercial ones at the gym in both quality and function.  It is heavy duty! We have had this for a few months and it is wonderful.  I used to get quite sore after my workouts, but when I stand on this for 10 minutes after, I have little if any muscle soreness.  I like to do squats and stretching on it primarily, or just simply stand on it but lots of exercises can be done.  It is a fun, positive and productive way to end the workout.  I do notice more toning in my legs in places I couldn’t get too. My legs and knees feel stronger as do my supporting muscles throughout my body. I do get vertigo often in general but I haven’t had any issues in vertigo being triggered when using this and I think this is helping it improve.  I definitely feel drainage that I didn’t even realize I had from my sinuses during and after using this.  It is not too loud, so I can hear the television over this without turning up my television at all. The Bluetooth does work well, but the quality of the speakers is not great but if you have no other speakers to use, it is a plus to have. My kids love it to stand and sing on since it makes their voices sound funny. I don’t ever worry about my children damaging it as it’s so study and well built.  Even though it is heavy duty, it is easy to move around because of its compact size. So when not in use we can put it on the closet floor or in a corner, and most people could lift it easily. The suction cups on it work very well on my laminate floor and it does not slide around at all when in use.  I have not used it on carpet so cannot attest to that.  I can definitely feel the circulation in my feet and legs getting better. I have issues with my legs hurting often since I am on my feet and legs all day and walk/run about 5 miles each day in addition to weight training. I cannot say enough about how my pain has subsided tremendously upon using this product.  I like how there is a remote to easily change settings while standing upon it.  I can’t say enough about this particular vibration plate!

reviews.title: Less joint pain, more jiggles.
reviews.body: I wasn't sure what to expect, but within the first 30 seconds, I discovered muscles (and apparently body parts) I didn't even know could jiggle. Things were shaking that have never volunteered for movement before.The vibration plate itself is fantastic. It's sturdy, easy to use, and definitely gives you a workout, even if you're just standing there wondering what life choices brought you to this moment.My only warning: the remote is very sensitive. Don't think about pointing it near the machine, it has to be pointed DIRECTLY at the screen to work.Overall, it's become part of my daily routine. It's effective, surprisingly fun, and provides just enough comedy to keep me coming back. Just make sure you've emptied your pockets—and maybe don't hold a cup of coffee while you're on it.
